prompt.task: Design the first three experiments for a new target before any target outcome is known. Optimize early best-so-far AUC first and final-best outcome second across the fixed sequential budget.

execution_protocol.later_rounds: The LLM will choose one experiment per round from a menu containing GP-UCB, source-prior, and geometric candidates.

decision_rules: Select exactly three unique IDs from candidate_shortlist.
Keep hypothesis and mechanism under 55 words each.
Use exactly three candidate assessments and keep each reason under 25 words.
Use at most three failure conditions and keep each under 25 words.
Select at least one candidate ranked in the top five by source evidence.
Use one plausible quality anchor, one mechanism discriminator, and one geometry probe.
The three candidates must include at least two public categorical condition signatures when possible.
At least one pair must differ materially in normalized numeric conditions.
Do not cluster all three candidates in the same local operating region.
Candidate assessments must cover all three selected candidates.
Source scores are priors, not target measurements. Never invent target outcomes.
prompt.evidence_boundary: No target outcomes are present in this prompt.

raw_response:
{
  "hypothesis": "Normalized aqueous solubility in ESOL rises monotonically with hydrogen-bonding heteroatom density at low molecular size, so the FreeSolv-optimal signature (hetero_high, aromatic_none, halogen_none, ring_token_low) will also mark the top ESOL region.",
  "mechanism": "Both hydration free energy and aqueous solubility are dominated by polar solvation: many O/N donors plus small nonpolar surface lowers desolvation penalty and crystal-lattice-competing hydration, while aromatic rings and halogens add hydrophobic surface and stacking energy that suppress solubility.",
  "selected_source_view": "same_substrate",
  "selected_candidate_ids": ["esol_common_1026", "esol_common_0282", "esol_common_0934"],
  "candidate_assessments": [
    {
      "candidate_id": "esol_common_1026",
      "role": "quality_anchor",
      "expected_outcome": 88.0,
      "confidence": 0.72,
      "reason": "Rank-1 in all source views; polyol inositol matches transferred hetero_high, aromatic_none, ring_low signature for maximal hydration."
    },
    {
      "candidate_id": "esol_common_0282",
      "role": "mechanism_probe",
      "expected_outcome": 66.0,
      "confidence": 0.5,
      "reason": "Barbiturate holds aromatic_none, ring_low but drops to hetero_mid with fewer OH donors, isolating H-bond-donor density effect."
    },
    {
      "candidate_id": "esol_common_0934",
      "role": "geometry_probe",
      "expected_outcome": 74.0,
      "confidence": 0.45,
      "reason": "Extreme corner: minimal size, zero heteroatoms; separates size-driven from polarity-driven solubility across the design space."
    }
  ],
  "failure_conditions": [
    "Methane outperforms inositol, indicating size not polarity dominates normalized solubility.",
    "Barbiturate exceeds inositol, falsifying monotone hydroxyl-donor-density transfer from FreeSolv.",
    "All three score below aromatic or halogenated shortlist candidates in later rounds."
  ],
  "confidence": 0.6
}
